truth: java.util.Properties continues a line only when it ends in an ODD number of backslashes (the last one is the
continuation, each pair before it an escaped backslash). a/ ends in two (an escaped backslash: no continuation, so
the -Duser.home= on the next line is a property of its own and the jvmargs of line 1 hold none), b/ in three
(continues: GU1 at the first physical line), c/ in four (no continuation), d/ in five (continues).
